review.evidence: The sole native Solana mint authority and its ordinary-signature execution were independently re-read on 2026-10-03; issuer Fireblocks statements do not establish independent MPC operators, a cryptographic onchain quorum or hold period. The report archive links distinct May, June, July and August 2026 AUP comparisons of Absa cash to issued supply less management-designated treasury exclusions, documenting recurring reserve-to-management-defined-circulation comparisons. Earlier month labels repeat the same January report URL and are not counted as nine distinct engagements. AUP is not a financial assurance opinion or prudential authorization: those recurring factual comparisons do not establish independently assured total-holder-liability reconciliation or an independently pinned issuer-supervision regime. Reconciliation and supervision are therefore unknown rather than granting the periodic/attestation-only mint rung. Legal trust and bankruptcy protection remain unproved. Current issuer direct app redemption is not live; the two-business-day promise is future-only. Exchange liquidity and par execution are not guaranteed: the observed Orca pool was approximately USD16,000 with no observed 24-hour volume, and VALR volumes were small. Independent operators and Fireblocks key custody for the identified ordinary signer remain unverified; there is no onchain multisig threshold or timelock. Observed CoinGecko circulation differs from the historical report and issued total; retain fresh provider market cap rather than a raw minted-supply override. The requested 90-day chart covered only about nine days; ZAR FX normalization is required before depeg conclusions. FSP53458 remains an issuer/parent claim without an independently pinned regulator row. These key-custody, Backing, exit, market-data and supervision qualifications do not leave an unidentified native mint control.
